text: 7月15日，中国人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，近年来，人民币在跨境贸易投融资等领域使用更加广泛，境外主体对人民币的融资需求增强。2026年上半年，熊猫债券发行超过1600亿元，同比增长超60%。
text_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that in recent years, the renminbi has been more widely used in cross-border trade and investment, with increased foreign demand for renminbi financing. In the first half of 2026, panda bond issuance exceeded 160 billion yuan, up over 60% year-on-year.
